reason: Both fully satisfy the hard requirements (phases with percentages/entry criteria, five correctly formatted RISK lines, no same-phase decommission, numeric halt thresholds, correct PHASES line), but Response B handles the decommissioning constraint more rigorously by making it an explicit, fully-specified phase with its own entry criteria and 0% user allocation rather than a brief aside deferred to an undefined 'Phase 5,' and its halt criteria (e.g., halting on any single Sev1 incident) are more appropriately conservative for a financial billing system than Response A's more permissive threshold of allowing two Sev1 incidents before halting.
